The message inside was written in pencil on a page torn from a school exercise book. He read it twice, then put it in his coat pocket and walked back up the ninety-eight steps.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市还没有醒透。环路上一排排路灯把光铺在空荡的路面上，偶尔有出租车驶过，尾灯拖出一道红线。写字楼的玻璃幕墙映着尚未退去的夜色，几扇窗还亮着，像有人忘了关。早餐铺的蒸笼已经冒起白汽，送货车停在路边，司机靠在车头抽烟。清洁工推着水车慢慢走过，水痕在灯下泛着光。风从楼与楼之间穿过，带着一点凉。整座城像在屏息，等着天亮以后重新开口说话。", "w03": "- Recursion is when a job solves a small piece of itself and then hands the rest of the job to a copy of itself.\n- Every copy must get a smaller job, like counting down from ten to nine to eight, or it will never finish.\n- You need a stopping point, such as reaching one, where the copy just answers without asking for help again."}
